name: Hangzhou Diagens Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Diagens Biotechnology Co., Ltd., a medical devices company, develops medical imaging products and services. It operates through Medical Imaging Software and Medical Devices, Technology Licensing, Analysis and Consulting Services, and Others segments.
